messages:
Devon: Hey infra — onboarding for customer 'NovaAI' needs capacity in ap-east-1. Requesting 4 p5 instances, 10 g5 instances, and 2 p4d for an initial pilot. Account ID 123456789012. Also need ENI and vCPU bumps.
Priya: Hi Devon — can you confirm whether this is Dedicated or shared pool? Also need preferred AZs and expected sustained hours. ENI and vCPU are common blockers.
Devon: They'll be on Dedicated pools. AZs: ap-east-1a / ap-east-1b. Sustained ~1200 node-hours/month. Initial eval needs the 2 p4d for 72 hours each.
Josh_infra: Opening quota requests now. Using AWS CLI snippet: 
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-ABCDEF --desired-value 4
```
Also submitting ENI and vCPU quota increases. Will attach justification.
Devon: Account ENI shows 200 today — need 600. vCPU soft limit is 1000, bump to 2500 requested.
Linh: FYI ap-east-1 currently has constrained p5 supply. We might only get partial p5 immediately. AWS previously quoted 2–3 week for full p5 entitlements in this region.
Devon: That's a problem. Can we offer a hybrid plan? Customer prefers APAC locality but can tolerate a short fallback region.
Priya: We can provide Dedicated pilot in us-west-2 while ap-east quotas settle. Suggest routing critical traffic to us-west-2 until ap-east capacity confirmed.
Josh_infra: SR created: SR-0ABC12345. Requested quotas: p5 -> 4, g5 -> 10, p4d -> 2. AWS asked for usage justification and monthly hours. Devon please paste the justification text.
Devon: Justification: "Low-latency inference for APAC enterprise customer (NovaAI). Expected baseline 24/7 autoscaled capacity, ~1,200 node-hours/month, burst for experiments. Will use autoscaling + prefix cache to limit sustained peak. Dedicated tenancy required for data isolation."
SRE-Bot: quota-request-checker: Missing org IAM role 'QuotaRequester' on account 123456789012. Please attach org-level permission or AWS will deny the quota change.
Linh: Granting the role now. Also creating support case for ENI quota increase L-ENI-0001 -> 800.
Josh_infra: AWS response: can approve 2 p5 in ap-east-1 immediately, remainder subject to capacity redistribution. g5 and p4d quotas approved. They recommended reservation for guaranteed capacity.
Devon: Ok proceed with 2 p5 now and full approval for g5/p4d. Open follow-up for remaining 2 p5 and request ETA from TAM.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll loop in account team and schedule call with AWS TAM for capacity planning early next week.
Devon: Cost note for sales/finance — estimated monthly on-demand spend for this baseline ~ $125k/month. Flagging to Omar.
Omar: Noted. I'll add to the cost tracker and evaluate 1yr reserved options vs on-demand. Likely savings with RI or savings plan.
Josh_infra: Logging case URL: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=SR-0ABC12345
Devon: Thanks. I'll message NovaAI: initial plan = 2 p5 now + g5/p4d within 48h; remaining 2 p5 pending AWS capacity. Will update timeline after TAM call.
SRE-Bot: Reminder set: create compute-utilization alarms for nova-prod in ap-east-1 after provisioning.
